Current period to now, compared with the previous period through the corresponding local date/time. Calendar lengths may differ. These are recorded figures, not proof of business growth.
No sales records in the previous comparison period. A sales change cannot be calculated; missing records do not mean zero activity.
Days with entries: %1$d · Marked no trade: %2$d · Without records or marker: %3$d

Coverage is not accuracy or a credit score. Missing days are unknown. Local device time and history are not independently verified. Corrections can be legitimate.
Self-recorded by the owner; not independently verified. This is not a credit score or a promise of finance.

Deni is the current outstanding amount when this statement was generated, not the balance at the end of a historical period. Received payments include old Deni collections and are not a cash or wallet balance.
Includes aggregate business figures. Individual customer names, phone numbers and payment references are excluded.
Choose where to save or whom to share with. Apen cannot confirm receipt, Inuka acceptance or recall a file after you send it. Cancel to keep this preview on your phone.

The CSV fingerprint helps compare copies. It does not prove the transactions happened or that a lender verified them.
Reason for stock or price change
Record a business expense, such as transport, rent or electricity. Keep stock purchases distinct when reviewing costs.
Your PIN protects business records on this phone. Keep an encrypted backup and its separate password safe. Losing both the PIN and backup password can prevent recovery.

Use your encrypted Apen backup, its password and the owner username saved in that backup. This replaces records on this phone with that backup and sets a new owner PIN. Later records on this phone will be lost. R1 backups did not contain loan notes. If you have neither a usable backup nor its password, this recovery cannot recover your records.
Backup restored and owner PIN reset. Restart Apen and sign in with that owner username and your new PIN.
I understand this replaces this phone’s records with the selected backup.
Recovery did not finish. Check the backup, password, owner username and new PIN. The selected backup must be compatible with this Android version.
New businesses start with empty records. Training data is not loaded into a new business.
Corrections and removals retain original values in local change history. Older backups and files you already shared are not erased.
